    Maximal walks in band block quivers #

    In a band block quiver each position has one traversal to the right (along l_p) and one to the left (along l_{p-1}⁻¹), with opposite signs. The maximal walks from p are the two periodic half-words rightW p, leftW p, so the pair functors of a band module are counted by its positions (band_gr_eq).

    S.IsHW v s (List.ofFn fun (i : Fin m) => f ↑i)

    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.eq_succ_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (b : CWord D.Q) (p q : Fin b.n) :
    p = b.succ q ↔ q = b.pred p

    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.next_eq_some_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : Alt S b) (a : D.Q.A) (i j : Fin b.n) :
    b.next a i = some j ↔ b.lt i = (a, true) ∧ j = b.succ i ∨ b.lt (b.pred i) = (a, false) ∧ j = b.pred i
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.trav_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : Alt S b) {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] (φ : V ≃ₗ[k] V) (p q : Fin b.n) (l : Letter D.Q) :
    (blockQuiver S b hA V φ).Trav p l q ↔ l = b.lt p ∧ q = b.succ p ∨ l = (b.lt (b.pred p)).inv ∧ q = b.pred p
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.en_pred {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : Alt S b) (p : Fin b.n) :
    S.en (b.lt (b.pred p)) = !S.st (b.lt p)
